question: From an outside point P, two tangents, PA and PB, are drawn to a circle.A third tangent to the circle at a point Q intersects PA and PB at R and S respectively. If PA=10 cm, what is the perimeter of △PRS?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a triangle formed by two tangents from an external point and a third intersecting tangent, a direct property applies:

Perimeter of ▵PRS = 2 × Length of the tangent from the external point

Perimeter = 2 × PA

Perimeter = 2 × 10 = 20 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

PA = 10 cm

PA and PB are tangents to the circle from point P.

RS is a tangent at point Q intersecting PA at R and PB at S.
